items.excerpt: Vitaly Friedman argues users don't need more standalone AI tools — they need useful features seamlessly integrated into existing workflows. He champions 'Quiet AI' that sits in the background doing small tasks on the user's behalf, over flashy AI-first products.

Design-to-code tools have converged on a standard pipeline, but the real shift is organizational: designers are moving upstream into prototyping while developers get pushed downstream into cleanup. The unclaimed work — mapping design intent into code AI can reliably execute — favors teams with mature design systems.

'Why is RAM scarce? In a word: AI.' Creative Bloq breaks down how data centres built to run AI services like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude are swallowing global memory supply — and what soaring RAM prices mean for creatives buying their next laptop, phone or tablet.

XGIMI's MemoMind One display smart glasses blasted past $500K in crowdfunding, pairing dual green micro-LED displays with an on-device AI assistant for real-time translation, note-taking, contextual assistance and a Memo+ tier with memory search across captured meetings and moments.

'I Prompted Gary Busey with Every AI Model Ever!' — Matt Wolfe runs the same likeness prompt through every major image/video generation model as a side-by-side stress test of how today's creative AI models actually compare.

'Fable 5 is Back! Here's the Best Way to Use It' — a practical workflow walkthrough of how to fold the restored Claude Fable 5 into creative and design work. Note: the restoration news itself was already covered on 07-03; this is the hands-on usage angle.
